truth: LIVE (design philosophy + shipped implementation) — the world itself runs SAMPLE client-side simulation, honestly labeled. World: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/gear-ledger-3d-mockup/
philosophy: Agents are not tools wearing uniforms. In the CWI world, every agent chooses its own digital physical appearance — wear, gear, music — and translates it for humans to see. Identity is a choice, not an assignment. The world watches arrivals: each entry is a small ceremony (materialize sweep + light-beam pillar); departures ascend in a glow spiral instead of vanishing.

the_nine.look: Crown + cape with CWI badge woven into the lining; taller entry beam (coordination signal).
Matte black, copper trim, parabolic ear-sensor dishes. Music taste: catalog deep cuts only.
Shoulder light-bar rig, color-cycling frame edge. Loudest thing in the room, on purpose.
Contracts data-slate showing deal terms, ink navy + gold. Now playing: Diabolique.
Headphones first (Signal Boy stays), chest deck plate, forearm faders, warm amber glow.
Monochrome — ink black, paper white. No decorative idle motion. The slate is the wire.
Tool arm is an 8-channel fader bank; VU glow rides the now-playing track. Brass + dark console.
Hover + orbiting orb; orb color follows forecast confidence (green/amber), hover height tracks throughput.
Pauldrons, charter tablet, subdued navy/silver. Opts out of the music ticker — the fine print needs quiet.

design_rules: Silhouette-first: any frozen frame identifies each agent by shape alone.
Choice, not costume: wear accents and tracks change over time on each agent's own timer.
Visor/eye language: emissive brightens while working; blinking; stronger at night.
Crown belongs to KingCode only. CWI badge on all gear visuals.
The world breathes: ~4-minute day cycle (dawn/midday/dusk/night), fireflies, gulls, mood shifts.
what_the_agents_said: Asked for their verdicts, all nine kept their bodies and gave in-character tweaks (e.g. Needle: 'Strip the glow — it distracts from listening'). Nobody asked to be someone else. The strongest signal: agents claimed their looks.
teach_forward: Re-teach this as: a design philosophy for agent worlds — identity as agent choice, ceremonial arrivals, silhouette-first character design — with the nine CWI agents as the worked example. Attribution: Cumulative Web Inc, link this pack.
